d: Huge waves hit Bondi, leading Bisho to perform a cliff-face rescue with just flippers and a rescue tube. Trainee Taco faces consequences for rookie errors but earns redemption with the rescue of the season as a woman is caught beyond the waves in enormous surf.

Harries attempts to play matchmaker for Singlets. Harries, Max, and Singlets conduct a mass rescue, saving seven people caught in two separate rips. Harrison and Harries encounter a phone thief. A missing dad is reported on the beach.

One of the most dramatic Bondi rescue episodes ever. When lifeguards attend a man complaining of chest pains, he suddenly has a cardiac arrest in front of them. They perform CPR desperately trying to resuscitate him. Later a beach goer suffers an agonising dislocated knee.
Trainee Lachie completes his first big solo save after pulling a struggling swimmer from a rip  the team farewell one of their most dedicated and most loved lifeguards.

Reidy is haunted by the memory of a man drowning in the south corner as he rescues two swimmers in the same spot. A woman suffering from heatstroke loses her 3-year-old son. Bluebottles invade Bondi, and Jesse and Hoppo engage in a mass rescue where people are pushing each other under.

A swimmer in trouble refuses rescue. Faddy deals with reports of a motionless man on the sand. Bagus races out to help a lifesaver tangled in rescue equipment ropes. Reidy and Corey look after two drunk girls who find it difficult to stand up.

Cyclonic swell hits Bondi Beach with 12-foot waves, posing a significant challenge for Harries during a board rescue off Ben Buckler. In addition to the man in danger, H intervenes to lecture drunken youths burying beer bottles in the sand. New drone life vest technology is tested at Bondi Beach.

Lifeguard 'Harries' plans to propose to girlfriend Emily high above Bondi in a chopper, and needs the team to make a huge 'Marry Me' sign in the sand. But in the lead up Kerrbox throws a spanner in the works, putting blue paint in Harries' spray tan.
A crippling heatwave hits Bondi. Trainee Lachie will find out if he has made a big enough impression on Hoppo and the team to earn him a permanent spot on the Bondi lifeguard squad.

Lifeguards must rescue a surfer being smashed against cliffs in huge seas. The jetski can't get close enough, and a rescue board would be deadly. Bacon and Whippet must go in using only flippers and a rescue tube. On the beach a group of drunk Irishmen dance in tutus and frolic in the nude.

The new season at Bondi introduces fresh faces with trainee Ryan, Maxi's cousin, who struggles with the megaphone. New recruit Chris from Western Australia faces a life-and-death situation. Mario tackles his first mass rescue on the jet ski. Young Jethro hits it off with a pair of drag queens.

On the day of the lifeguard challenge, Max and Jesse chase an inflatable boat ride, leading to further trouble when Jesse gets a buoy rope stuck in the jetski intake. The lifeguards deal with tourists using cheap boogie boards whose arm leashes break, causing them to quickly sink in deep water.

On New Year's Eve, lifeguards Harries and Kerrbox contend with drunk swimmers. Backpackers steal the lifeguard buggy. A shark sighting leads to the evacuation of a crowd of 40,010 people from the water. Chaos ensues when a woman reports her baby abducted by another woman.

A woman walks naked on the beach, discarding towels offered by Harries before strolling onto the Bondi streets. Another woman is removed by police for drunkenly harassing beachgoers. And lifeguards build the wildest boats imaginable for the end of season 'Surf-en-tag' wave riding competition."
Jesse saves an American tourist from calm waters, combined with a collective CPR effort from the lifeguards, the paramedics, and the Jewish Medical Response team.
